AnalyticsSummary.description: Headline numbers. Percentages are of *analysed* feedback, not of everything.
AnalyticsSummary.title: AnalyticsSummary

BatchPredictRequest.description: A batch of review texts to score with a single sentiment model.
BatchPredictRequest.title: BatchPredictRequest

Category.description: A category available to this organisation's analysis.
Category.title: Category

CategoryStat.description:
One row of the category breakdown.

`category_key` is null for the bucket holding results with no category: unclassified
items and those the sentiment gate skipped. That bucket is the emerging-issue signal, so
it is reported rather than dropped.
CategoryStat.title: CategoryStat

CurrentUser.description:
Who is signed in. `organisation` is null for a user who belongs to no organisation.

Deliberately no session token: it lives only in the HttpOnly cookie.
CurrentUser.title: CurrentUser

FeedbackDetail.description: One item, with the provenance a support conversation needs.
FeedbackDetail.title: FeedbackDetail

FeedbackItem.description: One piece of feedback with its current analysis, as a list row.
FeedbackItem.title: FeedbackItem

FeedbackPage.description: A page plus enough to render a pager without a second request.
FeedbackPage.title: FeedbackPage

ImportAccepted.description: The response to an upload: what was stored, what was not, and what happens next.
ImportAccepted.title: ImportAccepted

ImportRowError.description: One rejected row, identified by the line number in the customer's own file.
ImportRowError.title: ImportRowError

ImportSummary.description: An import batch as a customer sees it.
ImportSummary.title: ImportSummary

JobSummary.description: Progress of background work. `error` is a summary - never internal detail.
JobSummary.title: JobSummary

OrganisationContext.description: The organisation a signed-in user acts for. Decided by the server, never by the client.
OrganisationContext.title: OrganisationContext

RegisterRequest.description:
A new account, and the name of the new organisation it will own.

Unknown fields are refused with 422: there is no way to name an existing organisation, an
organisation id or a role here. The length caps are outer limits against huge payloads;
the real rules (services/auth.py) produce the specific messages.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

TextRequest.description: Plain text input — used by endpoints that don't need platform/model choice.
TextRequest.title: TextRequest

TrendPoint.description: One bucket of a time series. Periods with no feedback are absent, not zero-filled.
TrendPoint.title: TrendPoint

APIKeyCookie.description: Set by POST /api/v1/auth/login or /register. HttpOnly: a browser sends it automatically.
APIKeyCookie.name: feedbackiq_session

post.description: Validates the file, stores the valid rows for the signed-in user's organisation and queues analysis. Re-uploading an identical file creates nothing and returns the original import.

Used by the Upload page to score an uploaded CSV. Capped at 200 rows per call.

schema.title: Response Batch Api Sentiment Batch Predict Post

schema.title: Response Compare Api Sentiment Compare Post

schema.title: Response Models Api Sentiment Models Get

get.description: Counts, share and sentiment split per category, largest first. Grouped by the stable category key, so a renamed category keeps one row. The entry with a null `category_key` holds results with no category - unclassified items and those the sentiment gate skipped.

schema.title: Response Read Category Breakdown Api V1 Analytics Categories Get

get.description: Volume, sentiment split, unclassified share and average rating for one organisation. Percentages are of *analysed* feedback, so they are not diluted by items the worker has not reached yet.

Counts per day, week or month, bucketed with date_trunc in PostgreSQL. Feedback with no date of its own is grouped by when it was ingested, so the trend adds up to the summary. Periods with no feedback are absent rather than zero-filled.

schema.title: Response Read Trend Api V1 Analytics Trend Get

post.description: Sets the session cookie. 401 with the same message for an unknown email and a wrong password; 403 for a disabled account.
Ends the session and clears the cookie. Succeeds whether or not anyone was signed in.

get.description: The user's email and the organisation they act for, with their role. `organisation` is null for a user who belongs to no organisation. 401 when not signed in.

post.description: Creates a user, a new organisation they own, and signs them in by setting the session cookie. Registration always creates a *new* organisation; it cannot join an existing one. 422 for an invalid detail, 409 if the email already has an account.
post.summary: Create an account and a new organisation

get.description: The active taxonomy: this organisation's own categories plus the shared defaults. Retired research categories are excluded here, while the breakdown above still reports them if historical results reference them.

schema.title: Response Read Categories Api V1 Categories Get

get.description: One organisation's feedback, newest first, with its current analysis. Every filter is applied in the database. Items not yet analysed are included with null analysis fields; use `analysed=false` to find them.
